text:
maria.p: Quick heads-up — launching Smart Failover (hosted) + a new low-latency realtime model family (HorizonRT) to GA today for hosted API. :tada:

ana: Nice! What does Smart Failover do exactly?

maria.p: It transparently routes requests to a compatible regional/model fallback when the primary route is degraded or capacity constrained. Default policy is ON for new projects; can opt out per route in Console.

cody: Is this the thing that will kick in if a zone has high tail latency?

maria.p: Yup. It uses health + latency signals and a compatibility matrix to pick a fallback variant (same family, different quantization or region). Targets: keep p95 within SLA while reducing errors.

devex: Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/smart-failover — includes migration notes and sample SDK flags.

maria.p: Also GAing HorizonRT models (rt-small, rt-medium, rt-large) optimized for streaming + tool-calling. Endpoint additions: POST /v1/realtime/stream and /v1/generate-rt for non-streaming async gen.

jordan: Any breaking changes to existing realtime endpoints?

maria.p: No breaking changes to the old realtime paths. New endpoints are additive. One small change: the old fallback query param (fallback=false) is deprecated — use header x-rw-routing-policy: "no-fallback" instead. See migration guide.

deploy-bot: Deploy 1855.43 initiated by maria.p — canary 5% traffic, region us-west-2. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/1855.43

ana: How is rollout staged?

maria.p: Rollout plan: canary today (5%), ramp to 30% over 48h if metrics look good, full region rollout in 7 days. Region-by-region rollout across NA/EU/APAC. We will monitor p99/p95, error-rate, and token-cost delta.

eng-oncall: We'll have an oncall rotation watching the canary dashboard for the next 72h. If you see >2x error-rate or p99 regressions, ping #eng-oncall immediately.

cody: Will existing token/unit pricing change for HorizonRT?

maria.p: No pricing change for launch; HorizonRT has higher throughput per GPU so unit economics should be better for streaming use-cases. Any future pricing adjustments will be announced separately.

devex: Quick migration snippet — curl streaming example:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "x-rw-routing-policy: prefer-low-latency" \
  -d '{"model":"horizonrt-medium","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream
```
And JS SDK flag: client.options.routing = { allowFallback: true, priority: "latency" }

jordan: Who should we loop in for customer-facing release notes?

maria.p: Product will publish a customer-facing post by EOD; Marketing + CS already notified. Internal changelog entry: https://redwood.ai/internal/changelog#1855.43

ana: Thanks — i'll test the new rt endpoints with our demo app and report anything odd.

maria.p: Please do. If you spot anything funky, add it to the canary issues board and tag eng-oncall. Thanks everyone :rocket:
